svg.title: Waypoint Room outdoor heat pump portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional heating and cooling portfolio concept for Waypoint Room, showing a neatly installed outdoor heat-pump condenser with safe clearances. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
